purpose: Make each SPIDER event/document node grow a provenance-bearing contextual fur across successive passes: temporal, spatial, environmental, astronomical, geospace, aviation, space activity, witness, sensor, institutional, media, archive, conventional-hypothesis, contradiction and missingness facets.

metaphor.fur: A dense set of small contextual facets around a node.
metaphor.spiral_growth: Each pass may fill previously UNKNOWN facets, add independent corroboration, preserve conflicts, or leave a facet unresolved.
metaphor.critical_boundary: More fur means richer context, not a stronger extraordinary claim.

pass_behavior: extract source-bound facets from newly pulled records
generate acquisition tasks for every unresolved high-value field
merge new observations append-only with previous fur
do not increment evidence for identical replay
preserve contradictory values as conflicts instead of averaging
feed newly resolved facets back into SPIDER graph/frontier routing
export complete fur and pass history to HRAiN SPIDER Mode

aviation: public historical flight records where lawful

hrain.display: Per-node Context Fur panel with coverage, resolved observations, conflicts and acquisition queue.
hrain.source_authority: ZERO; TOPA source records and receipts remain authoritative.
